doorwisp.intro: A Hum Wisp drifts across the path to the old door!
won: The wisp is gone. Under the bluff, the old door hums on.
lost: You fall back to catch your breath. The wisp drifts back to where it hung.

underhall.intro: A Mossback and a Hum Wisp block the stair!
underhall.wonMsg: Victory! The humming fades from the hall.
underhall.lostMsg: You are driven back up the stair.
won: It has gone quiet. A row of lamp brackets runs along the wall, each one set very low.
Past the hall a second stair goes on down into the dark. The door will take you there.
lost: You climb back up the stair to catch your breath.
Again, when you are ready. A press as a blow lands makes it count for more. Mend and Tonics keep you standing.

wardens.intro: Two lamps swing down out of the dark. Nobody is holding them!
wardens.lostMsg: You are driven back from the balcony.
won: The lamps go out one after the other, the way lamps do at the end of a shift.
lost: You fall back to catch your breath. The lamps hang where they were, waiting.
